title: Chemist
description:
***Job Description***




  




* Responsible for preparation, review, issuance, and control of QA documents, SOPs, specifications, and records.
* Maintain document control systems in compliance with BRCGS, IFS, Fair Trade, HACCP, and GMP requirements.
* Coordinate and support external, customer, and internal audits by providing required documentation and evidence.
* Track audit observations, non\-conformities, CAPA, and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Maintain HACCP documentation, risk assessments, verification, and validation records.
* Review production and quality records to ensure compliance with food safety and quality standards.
* Manage master lists, document revisions, change controls, and record retention systems.
* Conduct documentation\-related training and create awareness on quality and food safety requirements.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure continuous audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
* Candidate should have 2–3 years of experience in QA documentation within the food/FMCG industry and hands\-on exposure to BRCGS, IFS, Fair Trade, and HACCP audits.
